units.source_text: 到后来我竟坐不住了，勉强自己这样坐下去的话，说不定会按捺不住闯进K的房间去。

en.t: In the end, I could no longer sit still; if I forced myself to keep sitting there, I might lose control and burst into K's room.

units.source_text: 我无可奈何地站起身走到檐廊上，从檐廊去了客厅，毫无目的地拿起铁壶，倒了一杯热水喝了下去，然后走出了家门。

en.t: With no other choice, I got up and went out to the veranda, then from there to the sitting room, where I aimlessly picked up the iron kettle, poured myself a cup of hot water, drank it, and then left the house.

units.source_text: 我就这样故意避开穿过K的房间，来到了大街上。

en.t: In this way, deliberately avoiding passing through K's room, I came out onto the street.

units.source_text: 我当然没有什么想去的地方。

en.t: Of course, there was nowhere in particular I wanted to go.

units.source_text: 只是因为在家里实在待不住了，所以漫无目的地在正月期间的大街上随意走了起来。

en.t: It was simply that I could not bear to stay at home, so I began wandering aimlessly through the New Year's streets.

units.source_text: 可是无论怎样走，我的脑袋里还是被K的事塞得满满的。

en.t: But no matter how much I walked, my head was still completely filled with thoughts of K.

units.source_text: 其实我并非为了不去想K出来乱走的，而是想好好琢磨琢磨他这个人才出来走走的。

en.t: In truth, I was not wandering around in order to stop thinking about K; rather, I had gone out to think him over carefully.
